question: What action is described for one who writes on another many-petaled leaf?
premises: Writing is done on another many-petaled leaf.
The person who writes then practices.
Practice follows the act of writing.
inference: One who writes on another many-petaled leaf and practices engages in that ritual use.
uncertainties: The consequence of this action is continued in the next verse.
plain_english: Whoever, having written on another many-petaled leaf, practices it.
